name: Er
overview: Er was a male member of the tribe of Judah, distinguished as the firstborn son of Judah. His role is primarily noted in the context of his family lineage within the tribe of Judah. No additional personal notes are recorded about him beyond his position as Judah's eldest son.
namesAndTitles: The name Er means 'watchful' or 'watcher' in Hebrew, reflecting a proper name given in the biblical text. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it carries a meaning that may imply vigilance or attentiveness.
familyAndRelationships: Er was the son of Judah and the husband of Tamar, as inferred from the biblical record. He is also noted as the father of Bath-shua. His death was caused by the Lord, indicating a significant divine action in his life.
scriptureSignificance: Er's significance in Scripture lies in his position as Judah's firstborn and his role in the family narrative involving Tamar. His death by divine intervention highlights God's sovereign judgment within the lineage of Judah. This event sets the stage for subsequent developments in the tribe of Judah's genealogy.
